Before I finalize my decision on the award and the recognition package — which includes a public announcement, a five-minute spotlight at the department meeting, and an invitation to represent the department on an external collaboration panel — I'd like to open the floor. This is the brief round for project colleagues and event staff to share any relevant input. Please go ahead.
